# Suit Station

> Family-owned men's suit shop in Gainesville, Georgia. Specializing in
> tailored suits, tuxedos, wedding suits, and on-site alterations. The shop
> has fitted over 1,000 customers and maintains a 4.9 / 5 average on Google
> reviews.

## Location & contact
- Business name: Suit Station
- Address: 150 Pearl Nix Pkwy, Gainesville, GA 30501, United States
- Phone: (470) 595-7775
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Sunday 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM
- Service area: Gainesville, GA · Hall County · North Georgia (Buford, Cumming, Flowery Branch, Oakwood, Dahlonega — anyone within ~30 miles of Pearl Nix Pkwy)

No purchase necessary. One-question qualifier filters intent. 7-day redemption window.

## Pricing (starting prices, USD)
- Suits: from $199 (full jacket + pants set; premium fabrics up to $399)
- Tuxedos: from $199
- Kids' 5-piece sets: $129.99
- Alterations: hem from $18; waist from $24; sleeves from $25; jacket sides from $40; same-day rush adds $10
- Wedding party setups: typically $400–$1,200 per person depending on fabric, construction, and accessories

## Services
- Suit and tuxedo sales (no rentals — the shop sells only)
- On-site alterations and tailoring (3–5 business days standard; same-day rush available)
- Coordinated wedding party fittings (groom, groomsmen, fathers, ring bearers)
- Coordinated prom party fittings (5–8 person groups, March rush window)
- Free 45-minute personalized styling sessions by appointment
- Walk-ins welcome
- Out-of-town groomsmen support (measurement guide, ship-ready suits with final on-arrival tweak)
- Kids' 5-piece sets sized for ring bearers and junior groomsmen

## Frequently asked questions
- **What is the price range?** Suits and tuxedos start at $199; premium fabrics up to $399. Wedding setups typically $400–$1,200 per person.
- **How long do alterations take?** 3–5 business days. Same-day rush available for an additional $10.
- **Walk-ins or appointments?** Both welcome. Appointments get dedicated tailor time and a private fitting room.
- **Do you do rentals?** No. The shop sells only — owning a tailored suit or tuxedo costs roughly the same as a high-end rental.
- **Can you handle wedding parties of 6+?** Yes. Book the groom first, and the rest of the party is coordinated from there.
- **How far in advance should we book a wedding?** For Saturday weddings in peak season (April–October), 4–6 months out is ideal. Rush fittings possible in 3–4 weeks.
- **Out-of-town groomsmen?** Yes — they fill out a measurement guide at their local tailor; the shop ships the suit ready to wear with a final tweak on arrival.
- **Can you turn around a same-week funeral suit?** Yes. The shop runs a dedicated same-week funeral queue with $10 same-day rush alterations.

## About the shop
Suit Station is family-owned and operated, located on Pearl Nix Parkway in Gainesville, Georgia. The shop has fitted over 1,000 customers for weddings, work, prom, and formal occasions. It carries 500+ suits in stock, employs master tailors on-site, and offers private appointments seven days a week. The shop's pricing model is one clear price with no hidden fees.
